## Basic Univariate Model Syntax 
$$
\begin{align}
\frac{dx_{t}}{dt} \: &= \: \mu_x \: + \: \beta_x \cdot x_{t} 
\end{align}
$$

```{r}
d <- as.data.frame(d)
tp <- nrow(d)
# colnames(d)
model_1 <- ctModel(
  type = "stanct"
  , manifestNames = c("EM01")
  , latentNames   = c("X")
  , LAMBDA        = matrix(c(1), nrow = 1, byrow = T)
  , DRIFT         = matrix(c("beta_x"), nrow = 1, byrow = T)
  , CINT          = matrix(c("mu_x"), nrow = 1, byrow = T)
  # , MANIFESTMEANS = matrix(c(0), nrow = 1)
  # , MANIFESTVAR   = matrix(c(0), nrow = 1)
  # , DIFFUSION     = matrix(c(0), nrow = 1, byrow = T)
  , id            = "id"
  , time          = "time"
  # , Tpoints       = tp
  )

ctModelLatex(model_1)

model1_fit <- ctStanFit(
  data = d
  , model_1
  )
summary(model1_fit)

ctKalman(model1_fit, plot = T)
p1 <- ctStanPostPredict(model1_fit, plot = F)
pred1 <- p1[[1]][[3]]$data %>% filter(Source == "Observed")
p1[[1]][[3]] + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0), linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_smooth(data = pred1, se = F, method = "lm", color = "blue") + 
  labs(
    title = "Sample Univariate Change as Outcome Model"
    , subtitle = "Estimated via ctsem package"
    ) + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = .5)
        , plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", hjust = .5)
        , legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(file = "~/Downloads/univar-cao.png", width = 6, height = 4)
test <- ctStanGenerateFromFit(model1_fit, fullposterior = TRUE, 
      nsamples = 200)

k1 <- ctKalman(model1_fit, removeObs = T)
ctsem::plot.ctKalmanDF(k1)

k1 %>% 
  filter(Element %in% c("y", "yprior")) %>% 
  select(Row, Element, Subject, Time, value) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "Element"
    , values_from = "value"
  ) %>% 
  drop_na() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = y, y = yprior, color = Row, group = Row)) + 
  geom_point()

# ctPlot(model1_fit, types=c('regression','kalman','priorcheck'))
                  
```

## Univariate Model Syntax (Main Effect of ER Goals)
Main effect = change in strength and subtle changes in location 

$$
\begin{align}
\frac{dx_{t}}{dt} \: &= \: \mu_x \: + \: \beta_x \cdot x_{t} \: + \: c_{x} \cdot y_{t}
\end{align}
$$

```{r}
center <- function(x) x - mean(x, na.rm = T)
d <- as.data.frame(d) %>% 
  mutate(EM02 = center(EM02))
tp <- nrow(d)
# colnames(d)
model_2 <- ctModel(
  type = "stanct"
  , manifestNames = c("EM01")
  , latentNames   = c("X")
  , LAMBDA        = matrix(c(1), nrow = 1, byrow = T)
  , DRIFT         = matrix(c("beta_x"), nrow = 1, byrow = T)
  , CINT          = matrix(c("mu_x"), nrow = 1, byrow = T)
  , MANIFESTMEANS = matrix(c(0), nrow = 1)
  , MANIFESTVAR   = matrix(c(0), nrow = 1)
  # , DIFFUSION     = matrix(c(0, 0), nrow = 1, byrow = T)
  , TDpredNames = c("EM02")
  , id            = "id"
  , time          = "time"
  # , Tpoints       = tp
  )

# model_2 <- ctModel(
#   type = "stanct"
#   , manifestNames = c("EM01", "EM02")
#   , latentNames   = c("X", "Y")
#   , LAMBDA        = matrix(c(1, 0
#                            , 0, 1), nrow = 2, byrow = T)
#   , DRIFT         = matrix(c("beta_x", "c_x"
#                              , "c_y", "beta_y"), nrow = 2, byrow = T)
#   , CINT          = matrix(c("mu_x", "mu_y"), nrow = 2, byrow = T)
#   , MANIFESTMEANS = matrix(c(0, 0), nrow = 2)
#   , MANIFESTVAR   = matrix(c(0, 0, 0, 0), nrow = 2)
#   , DIFFUSION     = matrix(c(1, 0,
#                              0, 0), nrow = 2, byrow = T)
#   , id            = "id"
#   , time          = "time"
#   , Tpoints       = tp
  # )

ctModelLatex(model_2)

model2_fit <- ctStanFit(
  data = d
  , model_2
  )

summary(model2_fit)

p2 <- ctStanPostPredict(model2_fit, plot = F)
pred2 <- p2[[1]][[3]]$data %>% filter(Source == "Model")
p2[[1]][[3]] + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0), linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_smooth(data = pred2, se = F, method = "lm", color = "blue") + 
  labs(
    title = "Sample Univariate Change as Outcome Model (Main Effect of Y)"
    , subtitle = "Estimated via ctsem package"

  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = .5)

ctKalman(model2_fit, plot = T)
k2 <- ctKalman(model2_fit, removeObs = T)

k2 %>% 
  filter(Element %in% c("y", "yprior")) %>% 
  select(Row, Element, Subject, Time, value) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "Element"
    , values_from = "value"
  ) %>% 
  drop_na() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = y, y = yprior, color = Row, group = Row)) + 
  geom_point()

```

## Univariate Model Syntax (Moderating Effect of ER Goals)
Moderating effect = change in location as a function of Y

$$
\begin{align}
\frac{dx_{t}}{dt} \: &= \: \mu_x \: + \: \beta_1 \cdot x_{t} \: + \: \beta_{2} \cdot y_{t} \: + \: \beta_{3} \cdot x_{t} \cdot y_{t}
\end{align}
$$

```{r}
d <- as.data.frame(d) %>% 
  mutate(EM01xEM02 = EM01*EM02)
tp <- nrow(d)
# colnames(d)
model_3 <- ctModel(
  type = "stanct"
  , manifestNames = c("EM01")
  , latentNames   = c("X")
  , LAMBDA        = matrix(c(1), nrow = 1, byrow = T)
  , DRIFT         = matrix(c("beta_x"), nrow = 1, byrow = T)
  , CINT          = matrix(c("mu_x"), nrow = 1, byrow = T)
  , MANIFESTMEANS = matrix(c(0), nrow = 1)
  , MANIFESTVAR   = matrix(c(0), nrow = 1)
  # , DIFFUSION     = matrix(c(0, 0), nrow = 1, byrow = T)
  , TDpredNames = c("EM02", "EM01xEM02")
  , id            = "id"
  , time          = "time"
  , Tpoints       = tp
  )

ctModelLatex(model_3)

model3_fit <- ctStanFit(
  data = d
  , model_3
  )

summary(model3_fit)

ctStanContinuousPars(model3_fit)

p3 <- ctStanPostPredict(model3_fit, plot = F)
pred3 <- p3[[1]][[3]]$data %>% filter(Source == "Observed")
p3[[1]][[3]] + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0), linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_smooth(data = pred1, se = F, method = "lm") + 
  labs(
    title = "Sample Univariate Change as Outcome Model (Main Effect of Y)"
    , subtitle = "Estimated via ctsem package"
    ) + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = .5)
        , plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", hjust = .5))

ctKalman(model2_fit, plot = T)
k2 <- ctKalman(model2_fit, removeObs = T)

k2 %>% 
  filter(Element %in% c("y", "yprior")) %>% 
  select(Row, Element, Subject, Time, value) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "Element"
    , values_from = "value"
  ) %>% 
  drop_na() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = y, y = yprior, color = Row, group = Row)) + 
  geom_point()

# ctPlot(model2_fit, types=c('regression','kalman','priorcheck'))
                  
```

## Bivariate Model Syntax 

$$
\begin{align}
\frac{dx_{t}}{dt} \: &= \: \mu_x \: + \: \beta_x \cdot x_{t} \: + \: c_{x} \cdot y_{t} \\
\frac{dy_{t}}{dt} \: &= \: \mu_y \: + \: \beta_y \cdot y_{t} \: + \: c_{y} \cdot x_{t}
\end{align}
$$

```{r}
d <- as.data.frame(d)
tp <- nrow(d)
# colnames(d)
model_4 <- ctModel(
  type = "stanct"
  , manifestNames = c("EM01", "EM02")
  , latentNames   = c("X", "Y")
  , LAMBDA        = matrix(c(1, 0
                           , 0, 1), nrow = 2, byrow = T)
  , DRIFT         = matrix(c("beta_x", "c_x"
                             , "c_y", "beta_y"), nrow = 2, byrow = T)
  , CINT          = matrix(c("mu_x", "mu_y"), nrow = 2, byrow = T)
  , MANIFESTMEANS = matrix(c(0, 0), nrow = 2)
  , MANIFESTVAR   = matrix(c(0, 0, 0, 0), nrow = 2)
  # , DIFFUSION     = matrix(c(0, 0, 0, 0), nrow = 2, byrow = T)
  , id            = "id"
  , time          = "time"
  , Tpoints       = tp
  )

ctModelLatex(model_4)

model4_fit <- ctStanFit(
  data = d
  , model_4
  )
summary(model4_fit)

p4 <- ctStanPostPredict(model4_fit, plot = F)
pred4 <- p4[[1]][[3]]$data %>%
  mutate(var = "EM01") %>%
  full_join(
    p4[[2]][[3]]$data %>%
    mutate(var = "EM02") 
  ) %>%
  group_by(var, Source) %>%
  mutate(n = 1:n()) %>%
  rename(d = y) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "var"
    , values_from = c("x", "d")
  ) 

pred4 %>%
  filter(Source == "Model") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x_EM01, y = x_EM02)) + 

p4[[1]][[3]] + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0), linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_smooth(data = pred1, se = F, method = "lm") + 
  labs(
    title = "Sample Univariate Change as Outcome Model (Main Effect of Y)"
    , subtitle = "Estimated via ctsem package"
    ) + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = .5)
        , plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", hjust = .5))
ctKalman(model4_fit, plot = T)

k <- ctKalman(model4_fit, removeObs = T)

k %>% 
  filter(Element %in% c("y", "yprior")) %>% 
  select(Row, Element, Subject, Time, value) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "Element"
    , values_from = "value"
  ) %>% 
  drop_na() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = y, y = yprior, color = Row, group = Row)) + 
  geom_point()

ctPlot(model4_fit, types=c('regression','kalman','priorcheck'))
                  
```

## Run Model 

```{r}
fit <- ctStanFit(
  datalong = d
  , ctstanmodel = stanmodel
  , objective = "Kalman"
  , stationary = F
  )
```


## Extract estimates 

```{r}
k <- ctKalman(fit)

k %>% filter(Element == "etaprior")

ctKalman(ctstantestfit, timerange=c(0,60))

#Multiple subjects, y and yprior, showing plot arguments
plot1<-ctKalman(fit, timerange=c(0,60), timestep=.1, plot=TRUE,
  subjects=1, 
  kalmanvec=c('y','yprior'),
  errorvec=c(NA,'ypriorcov'))
```
